effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` WETH (0x4200…0006) to the vault through safeTransferFrom.
The vault mints pythETH shares to `receiver`. The count is computed from the vault's total assets and supply, rounded down.
The vault may mint fee shares to the fee recipient first (_accrueFee). This sets the share price and dilutes no one beyond the stated fee.
formats.shown: Deposit: the WETH amount, the share ticker 'pythETH' as text, and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit: the number of pythETH shares the receiver gets is not shown; the code computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit(): `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` The descriptor shows only `"label": "Share ticker", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"`.
findings.fix: Nothing in calldata carries the share count. Keep the ticker field. Optionally rename it to 'Receive shares in'.

findings.title: deposit: the intent 'Deposit' names no asset, and there is no interpolatedIntent.

effects: The signer sends WETH to the vault. The amount is computed from `shares` and the vault's totals, rounded up. Only the signer's WETH allowance to the vault limits it.
The vault mints exactly `shares` pythETH to `receiver`.
The vault may mint fee shares to the fee recipient first (_accrueFee).
formats.shown: Mint: 'WETH' as text for the deposit asset, the exact pythETH share amount, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: mint: the WETH amount taken from the signer is computed on-chain and not shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol mint(): `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` ERC4626._deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets);` The descriptor shows only `"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"`.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the WETH amount. Rename the field to 'Pay with (amount set by share price)' so the signer knows the amount is not fixed.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint' does not say that WETH is deposited to get the shares.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Deposit WETH for pythETH shares'. Add the interpolatedIntent 'Mint {shares} for {receiver} by depositing WETH'.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns pythETH shares from `owner`. The count is computed from `assets`, rounded up.
When the signer is not `owner`, the call spends the signer's share allowance from `owner`.
The vault sends exactly `assets` WETH to `receiver`.
The vault may mint fee shares to the fee recipient first (_accrueFee).
formats.shown: Withdraw: the exact WETH amount, the receiver, and the owner whose shares are used.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of pythETH shares burned from the owner is computed and not shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw(): `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` ERC4626._withdraw: `_burn(owner, shares);`
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the share count. Optionally relabel 'Owner' to 'Burn shares from'.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent 'Withdraw' names no asset, and there is no interpolatedIntent.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` pythETH from `owner`.
When the signer is not `owner`, the call spends the signer's share allowance from `owner`.
The vault sends WETH to `receiver`. The amount is computed from the share price and rounded down. There is no minimum in calldata.
The vault may mint fee shares to the fee recipient first (_accrueFee).
formats.shown: Redeem: the exact pythETH share amount, the receiver, and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: redeem: the WETH amount the receiver gets is computed on-chain and not shown or bounded.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem(): `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);` No WETH field in the descriptor.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the WETH amount. Add a constant field 'Receive' = '$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker' so the signer knows the output asset.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names WETH as the asset received.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Redeem pythETH for WETH'. Add a raw field with the underlyingTicker constant.
